dashboard: The dashboard shows online users, interlockings, and your trains and vehicles. Use <addIcon></addIcon> to add a vehicle or train, and <throttleIcon></throttleIcon> in the top bar to open the throttle.
myVehicles: Manage your vehicles here. Use <addIcon></addIcon> to add a vehicle and <functionsIcon></functionsIcon> to configure decoder functions.
rentals: Rentals let you share vehicles and trains with other users on the layout, and take ones rented to you.
myTrains: My trains are sets of vehicles you run together. Create trains, edit order, and drive them from the throttle.
